# `connection` records

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from schemas/0.1/connection.schema.json. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

One explicit logical edge with a route (ADR-0007, doc 03 §9, rank 34). Page-owned when drawn; a
page-less connection (strip-editor bridge, internal link) lives in the shard of the device owning `a`.

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | `connection` |
| File | `pages/<page>.jsonl or devices/<xx>.jsonl` |
| Rank | 34 |
| Status | implemented |
| Record version | 1 |
| Schema | [`connection.schema.json`](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/schemas/0.1/connection.schema.json) |

## Types

### ConnectionKind

The kind of a connection (doc 08 §2.3). `Fluid(FluidLine)` (doc 11) and `SingleLine` (1.0) are additive
variants of their work packages; until then a file's value is kept as `ConnectionKind::Unknown`, which
joins no net (doc 05 §10.3 rule 3).

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**: One conductor (the default).

   Shape: `"wire"`

2. **Form 2**: A cable core or shield.

   Shape: object { `core`: [`Uuid`](#uuid) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `core` | [`Uuid`](#uuid) | yes |  | A lower-case hyphenated UUID (doc 05 §3.2). |

3. **Form 3**: A terminal bridge; joins potentials, never a wire.

   Shape: object { `bridge`: [`BridgeSpec`](#bridgespec) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `bridge` | [`BridgeSpec`](#bridgespec) | yes |  | A terminal bridge (doc 08 §2.3): the connections of one group are one bridge object. |

4. **Form 4**: A single-line bus connection between bus-port CPs.

   Shape: object { `bus`: [`BusLine`](#busline) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `bus` | [`BusLine`](#busline) | yes |  | A bus line and the cable that carries it (FR-CBL-008). |

5. **Form 5**: Excluded from nets.

   Shape: `"overview"`

6. **Form 6**: A link between CPs of two functions of one part that no FnDef declares.

   Shape: `"internal"`

### Endpoint

One end of a connection, a definition or a bond (ADR-0007, doc 03 §9): a connection point of a function
or a junction. Encoding (doc 05 §3.2): `{"cp": [function, idx]}` or `{"junction": id}`.

```
use ew_schema::Endpoint;

let e: Endpoint = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"cp":["d40b6e93-25f7-5c1a-9e8d-7a3f1c05b6e2",0]}"#).unwrap();
assert!(matches!(e, Endpoint::Cp(_, 0)));
```

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**: Connection point `idx` of a function; its ID `v5(function, idx)` is derived, never stored.

   Shape: object { `cp`: array of ([`Uuid`](#uuid), integer (format `uint16`, min 0, max 65535)) (at least 2 item(s), at most 2 item(s)) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `cp` | array of ([`Uuid`](#uuid), integer (format `uint16`, min 0, max 65535)) (at least 2 item(s), at most 2 item(s)) | yes |  |  |

2. **Form 2**: A junction.

   Shape: object { `junction`: [`Uuid`](#uuid) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `junction` | [`Uuid`](#uuid) | yes |  | A lower-case hyphenated UUID (doc 05 §3.2). |

### NumberSpec

The wire number of a connection (doc 03 §8.7).

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**: Not numbered; prints "?" (the default).

   Shape: `"unassigned"`

2. **Form 2**: A counter assigned by the numbering rule: `{"assigned": {"counter": n}}`.

   Shape: object { `assigned`: [`AssignedNumber`](#assignednumber) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `assigned` | [`AssignedNumber`](#assignednumber) | yes |  | The payload of `NumberSpec::Assigned`. |

3. **Form 3**: A frozen number (FR-NUM-011).

   Shape: object { `frozen`: [`Ident`](#ident) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `frozen` | [`Ident`](#ident) | yes |  | An identifier: non-empty, one line (no control character U+0000 to U+001F or U+007F to U+009F), without leading or trailing white space (the Unicode White_Space set); interior spaces are allowed (doc 05 §3.2). JSON Schema cannot express Unicode Normalization Form C; the reader rejects non-NFC text. |

### AssignedNumber

The payload of `NumberSpec::Assigned`.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `counter` | integer (format `uint32`, min 0) | yes |  | The counter. |

### Ident

An identifier: non-empty, one line (no control character U+0000 to U+001F or U+007F to U+009F), without leading or trailing white space (the Unicode White_Space set); interior spaces are allowed (doc 05 §3.2). JSON Schema cannot express Unicode Normalization Form C; the reader rejects non-NFC text.

Type: string (at least 1 character(s))

Pattern: `^[^\u0000-\u0020\u007F-\u00A0\u1680\u2000-\u200A\u2028\u2029\u202F\u205F\u3000](?:[^\u0000-\u001F\u007F-\u009F]*[^\u0000-\u0020\u007F-\u00A0\u1680\u2000-\u200A\u2028\u2029\u202F\u205F\u3000])?$`

### Pt2

A point [x, y] in nanometres, y downwards (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: array of (integer (min -9007199254740991, max 9007199254740991), integer (min -9007199254740991, max 9007199254740991)) (at least 2 item(s), at most 2 item(s))

### SourceRef

The import provenance of a record (doc 14 §2.3, ADR-0004 amendment 1): the lineage and the source key
from which the record's ID `v5(lineage namespace, key)` was derived.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `key` | string | yes |  | The source key, byte for byte (NFC), such as `qet:el:<uuid>`. |
| `lineage` | [`Uuid`](#uuid) | yes |  | The import lineage. |

### Uuid

A lower-case hyphenated UUID (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (at least 36 character(s), at most 36 character(s))

Pattern: `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$`

JSON Schema cannot express Unicode Normalization Form C; the reader rejects non-NFC text. |

### Csa

A cross-section: a Dec3 string in mm², {"awg": n} or {"kcmil": Dec3} (doc 08 §4.6).

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**

   Shape: [`Dec3`](#dec3)

2. **Form 2**

   Shape: object { `awg`: integer (min -128, max 127) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `awg` | integer (min -128, max 127) | yes |  |  |

3. **Form 3**

   Shape: object { `kcmil`: [`Dec3`](#dec3) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `kcmil` | [`Dec3`](#dec3) | yes |  | A canonical decimal string: at most three fraction digits, no trailing fraction zeros, no leading zeros, no plus sign, no "-0", no exponent, no white space, no unit (doc 05 §3.2). The pattern bounds the integer part to 16 digits; the exact i64 range of the thousandths (about 9.2 x 10^15) is checked by the reader. |

### Dec3

A canonical decimal string: at most three fraction digits, no trailing fraction zeros, no leading zeros, no plus sign, no "-0", no exponent, no white space, no unit (doc 05 §3.2). The pattern bounds the integer part to 16 digits; the exact i64 range of the thousandths (about 9.2 x 10^15) is checked by the reader.

Type: string (at most 21 character(s))

Pattern: `^(?:0|-?[1-9][0-9]{0,15}(?:\.[0-9]{0,2}[1-9])?|-?0\.[0-9]{0,2}[1-9])$`

### Nm

A length in nanometres (doc 05 §3.2). Written without fraction or exponent; JSON Schema cannot tell 5 from 5.0, the reader rejects the latter.

Type: integer (min -9007199254740991, max 9007199254740991)
